 News › News News › AIBE XXII admit card 2026 to be released today, check steps to download AIBE XXII admit card 2026 to be released today, check steps to download
 TNN Updated: Nov 14, 2026, 09:26 IST The Bar Council of India (BCI) is set to release the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) XXII admit card today, November 14, 2026. Candidates who have successfully registered for the examination and paid the application fee will be able to download their hall tickets once the link is activated on the official website, allindiabarexamination.com .
 To download the admit card, candidates will have to log in using their registration ID and password. The hall ticket is a mandatory document that candidates must carry to the examination centre. Entry will not be permitted without a valid admit card.
 The AIBE XXII will be conducted on November 29, 2026, in pen-and-paper mode. Candidates must carry a physical copy of the hall ticket to the examination centre. They must also bring valid photo identity proof along with the admit card.
 AIBE XXII Admit Card 2026 : Steps To Download 
 Once the admit card link is activated, candidates can follow the steps below to download their AIBE XXII hall ticket:
 Step 1: Visit the official website, allindiabarexamination.com .
 Step 2: Click on the 'Admit Card' link available on the homepage.
 Step 3: A new login page will appear on the screen.
 Step 4: Enter the required login credentials, including the registration number and password.
 Step 5: Submit the details. The admit card will appear on the screen.
 Step 6: Download the hall ticket and save it for future reference.
 Details Mentioned On AIBE XXII Admit Card 
 After downloading the admit card, candidates should carefully verify the details mentioned on it. These include:
 Roll number
 Candidate's name
 Reserved category
 Examination centre address
 Examination timings
 Examination date
 Candidate's signature
 Candidate's photograph
 Candidates should ensure that all the details mentioned on the hall ticket are correct. They will also not be permitted to leave the examination hall before the examination concludes without handing over their answer sheet.
